newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch state to redeem 6.25 pct bond due 1998/2002.
newsitem.headline: Dutch state to redeem 6.25 pct bond due 1998/2002.

text.p: The Dutch government will exercise its right to early redemption of its 6.25 percent bond due 1998/2002, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.
The bond, of which 217 million guilders is outstanding, will be redeemed on March 15 at 102 percent of its face value.
Originally issued in 1987, the bond was scheduled to be redeemed gradually between 1998 and 2002.
The government no longer issues "broken maturity" bonds, having switched to fixed-maturity "bullet" bonds some years ago.
The Finance Ministry said the 6.25 percent 1998/2002 bond was the last outstanding publicly issued bond which granted the government the right of early redemption.
In addition to publicly issued bonds, the government used to place some of its debt directly with institutional investors.
Some of this debt is still oustanding although the government now borrows exclusively by means of public issues.
